info.title: QRKit - QR Code & Barcode Generator
info.description: # QRKit: QR Code and Barcode Generator Generate crisp QR codes (URL/text, Wi-Fi, vCard) and 1D barcodes (EAN, UPC, Code 128 and more) as PNG, scalable SVG or base64 JSON with one GET request. Responses are images you can drop straight into an ``. **Who it's for:** e-commerce, ticketing, restaurant menus, marketing, inventory and label printing, and any no-code tool that needs an image URL. ## Use cases - Put a QR code linking to an order or ticket on emails and PDFs. - Print Wi-Fi QR codes for cafés, offices and Airbnb guests. - Add vCard QR codes to business cards and email signatures. - Generate EAN-13/UPC-A barcodes for product labels and ISBN barcodes for books. - Embed SVG codes in print artwork at any size without blurring. ## Quickstart Subscribe on RapidAPI (a free plan is available), copy your key, then: ```bash curl --request GET \ --url 'https://qrkit-qr-code-barcode-generator.p.rapidapi.com/qr?text=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com&size=300&format=png' \ --header 'X-RapidAPI-Key: YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY' \ --header 'X-RapidAPI-Host: qrkit-qr-code-barcode-generator.p.rapidapi.com' ``` ## Authentication Every request goes through RapidAPI. Send `X-RapidAPI-Key` (your key) and `X-RapidAPI-Host` (`qrkit-qr-code-barcode-generator.p.rapidapi.com`) on every call. Requests that bypass the gateway are rejected with `403`. ## Good to know - Images are returned as binary by default; use `format=base64` to receive JSON with a data URI instead. - Image responses are cacheable for 24 hours (`Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400`). - Hex colours are given without `#` (or URL-encode it as `%23`). ## Rate limits and plans Request quotas and per-second limits depend on the RapidAPI plan you subscribe to; see the Pricing tab. When a limit is reached the gateway returns `429 Too Many Requests`; retry with exponential backoff or move to a higher plan. ## Errors All errors are JSON. The API returns `{"error": ""}` with a meaningful HTTP status: `422` missing or invalid parameter. Gateway errors (`401`/`403`/`429`) come from RapidAPI as `{"message": ""}`. ## Data sources and licences - QR encoding by the open-source segno library; barcodes by python-barcode. - QR Code is a registered trademark of DENSO WAVE INCORPORATED. ## MCP (AI agents) This API is also available as a Model Context Protocol server at `POST /mcp` on the same RapidAPI host; see the MCP endpoint for setup.

get.description: Encodes any text or URL (up to 2000 characters) as a QR code. Choose PNG, SVG or base64 JSON, size, margin, error-correction level and colours, including transparent backgrounds.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Content to encode: a URL, text, payment string and so on. Max 2000 characters. `data` is accepted as an alias.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output: `png` (binary image), `svg` (binary SVG) or `base64` (JSON with a data URI).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Target image width in pixels (values outside 64-2000 are clamped). The QR is scaled by whole modules, so the actual size may be slightly smaller.

parameters.name: margin
parameters.description: Quiet zone width in modules (0-20, clamped). 4 is the QR standard.

parameters.name: ecc
parameters.description: Error-correction level: L (~7%), M (~15%), Q (~25%), H (~30%). Use H if you overlay a logo.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Foreground (dark module) colour as 3- or 6-digit hex without `#`, or `transparent`.

parameters.name: bg
parameters.description: Background colour as 3- or 6-digit hex without `#`, or `transparent`.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Only with `format=base64`: encode the data URI as `png` or `svg`.

200.description: The QR code. PNG or SVG bytes by default (cached for 24 h via Cache-Control), or JSON when `format=base64`.

parameters.name: hidden

get.description: Generates retail and logistics barcodes: Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, ISBN-13, ISSN, ITF and PZN. Check digits are calculated for you: send 12 digits for EAN-13 (if you send 13, the last digit is recalculated, so a wrong check digit is silently corrected). Returns `422` with the reason when the data does not fit the symbology.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Data to encode, max 80 characters. Must suit the type (EAN-13: 12 or 13 digits, EAN-8: 7 or 8, UPC-A: 11 or 12). `data` is accepted as an alias.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Barcode symbology.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output: `png`, `svg` or `base64` (JSON with a data URI).

parameters.name: show_text
parameters.description: Print the human-readable digits under the bars. Any value other than `false` means true.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Only with `format=base64`: encode the data URI as `png` or `svg`.

200.description: The barcode. PNG or SVG bytes by default (cached for 24 h via Cache-Control), or JSON when `format=base64`.

422.description: Invalid parameter or data that does not fit the barcode type.

example.error: Invalid data for ean13: EAN must have 12 digits, not 2.

format.description: Image format inside the data URI.

ValidationError.description: Unprocessable: a required parameter is missing or a value is invalid. The `error` text says which.

example.error: A required parameter is missing or invalid

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests: your RapidAPI plan's rate limit or monthly quota was exceeded. Back off and retry, or upgrade your plan.
